vision.name: Goku Black
vision.text:
(Zamasu only. Once per combat you may place this card into play from your hand at 2 stages above 0 to discard a card from your opponent's hand. You may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Foresee 2. Banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile.
